instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the missing word.

atoms.a: Everyone was on time for the ((rehearsal)) today.
atoms.b: Everyone was on time for the ((rehearsal)) today.

atoms.a: Legend has it that you can become immortal by drinking from the Fountain of Youth.
atoms.b: Legend has it that you can become ((immortal)) by drinking from the Fountain of Youth.

atoms.a: Religion in the medieval period took the form of Crusades, through which Western European Christians tried to expand Christendom and wipe out other religions.
atoms.b: Religion in the ((medieval)) period took the form of Crusades, through which Western European Christians tried to expand Christendom and wipe out other religions.

atoms.a: In 14th to 17th century England, a church could legally act as a sanctuary for fugitives and make them immune to arrest.
atoms.b: In 14th to 17th century England, a church could legally act as a ((sanctuary)) for fugitives and make them immune to arrest.

atoms.a: Today in the library, she made the acquaintance of a nice new boy.
atoms.b: Today in the library, she made the ((acquaintance)) of a nice new boy.

atoms.a: Although nuclear energy is a low-carbon fuel, the risk of a further catastrophe has motivated some governments to shut down their nuclear power plants.
atoms.b: Although nuclear energy is a low-carbon fuel, the risk of a further ((catastrophe)) has motivated some governments to shut down their nuclear power plants.
